result.content: I don’t have a standard phrase because there *is* no standard—this district never updated its protocol after '89. That’s the problem. The logs are handwritten, sometimes in pencil, and half the time it just says “disconnected” with no follow-up. What I’m looking for is the closest thing to a paper trail that shows intent to permanently kill the circuit: a supervisor’s initials next to “Circuit 7B decommissioned per safety review” or “terminated at source, not to be re-energized.” Even “sealed off at panel” with a date and signature would help. I’m not expecting perfection—just something that wasn’t scribbled during a coffee break. Tomorrow I’ll bring you a photocopy of the 1997 page if I find it. Until then, I need to know what words *would* mean something, so I know what to look for.
